title: Octave Launches AI Facilities Tool
summary: Octave has launched a cloud-based platform that combines building, space, maintenance, and operational data with digital twin capabilities.

title: Siemens and Swinburne Expand Energy Alliance
summary: Siemens and Swinburne are expanding their energy alliance across Asia, with a training and innovation node planned for Malaysia by 2026.

title: Ensuring Safety for Autonomous Farm Robots
summary: Safe agricultural autonomy requires matching safeguards to the machine, its environment, and nearby people.

title: AI Complicates Semiconductor Chip Testing
summary: Rapidly changing workloads, additional test insertions, and fragmented data are creating challenges for chip testing.

title: Predictive Models Identify Marginal Chips
summary: Manufacturers are utilizing test data and predictive models to determine which passing chips require additional screening.

title: AI Reshapes Semiconductor Design and Efficiency
summary: Artificial intelligence is reshaping the tools, data, and collaboration models used across silicon design, manufacturing, and testing.

title: New AFM Modes Handbook Released
summary: A comprehensive guide has been released to help expand materials research capabilities using atomic force microscopy.

title: Addressing Silicon Photonics Process Control Challenges
summary: Connected inspection, metrology, and software are helping manufacturers move silicon photonics toward high-volume production.

title: Rapidus Reports Delays in 2nm SRAM Production
summary: Japan's state-backed Rapidus has failed to produce a functioning 2nm SRAM, casting doubt on its mass production targets.

title: Gallium Oxide Wafers Enter Early Production
summary: Gallium oxide wafers are moving into early production, offering an ultra-wide bandgap significantly wider than SiC.

title: New Development Platform for Humanoid Robots
summary: Inova Semiconductors showcased a development platform for humanoid robots utilizing high-speed networking and low-power FPGAs at electronica 2026.

title: MIT-Led Team Receives Funding for Next-Gen Herbicides
summary: Researchers received up to $53 million from ARPA-H to use AI in generating safer herbicides and improving food supply security.

title: CERN Finds Evidence of Rare Particle Decay
summary: CERN scientists discovered evidence of a particle decay occurring once in roughly 10 billion decays, ending a 40-year search.

title: PhysFVN: Illumination-Aware Visible-NIR Fusion for rPPG
summary: Researchers propose PhysFVN, an illumination-aware visible-NIR fusion framework using vision-language models for remote photoplethysmography.

title: Eco Wave Power Completes Phase 1 of Digital Twin
summary: Eco Wave Power finished Phase 1 of its AI-powered digital twin program focusing on wave interaction modeling.

title: NRG Energy Sells Gas Generation Portfolio to LS Power
summary: NRG Energy is selling six gas plants back to LS Power for $4 billion in a major portfolio shakeup.

title: NHA Backs BAAJA for Hydropower Reform
summary: The National Hydropower Association supports the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act of 2026 for its potential hydropower reforms.

title: PJM Expects Sufficient Winter Capacity
summary: Despite tightening reserve margins and growing demand, PJM expects to have adequate operational capacity to serve its peak this winter.

title: DreamLander Reinforcement Learning Planetary Lander
summary: Researchers presented DreamLander, a model-based reinforcement learning algorithm to generate optimal guidance and control for entry, descent, and landing problems.

title: Simulating Vein Compressibility for Ultrasound-Guided Access
summary: A physics-based simulation in NVIDIA Isaac Sim was tested to reproduce tissue mechanics and vein compressibility for robotic ultrasound-guided femoral access.

title: Starfish Space Loses First Otter Spacecraft
summary: Starfish Space's first Otter servicing spacecraft suffered an orbital glitch, terminating its NASA technology demonstration mission.

title: Sliding Payload Improves Dual-UAV Load Distribution
summary: An analysis of dual-drone payload transportation shows that allowing the load to slide along a connecting rope improves tension balance and disturbance rejection.

title: Learning World Models via S-Information for Robot Control
summary: Researchers introduced backward dynamics and inverse dynamics action predictors to improve latent embeddings and planning efficiency in robot world models.

title: NASA Launches $1M Moon Base Student Challenge
summary: NASA initiated a $1 million challenge asking students to solve lunar base problems to help build humanity's future on the moon.

title: Differentiable Inverse Rendering for Intravascular OCT Tissue Characterization
summary: A new gradient-based inverse rendering method recovers per-pixel optical attenuation from clinical intravascular optical coherence tomography images without training data.

title: Nonlinear Control Strategy for UAV Swarm Target Encirclement
summary: Researchers propose a hierarchical geometric Lyapunov-based control framework to achieve stable cooperative target encirclement by multiple UAVs in 3D space.

title: Validation Protocol for Radiomic Survival Analysis in Small Cohorts
summary: A four-step validation protocol helps address overfitting and high variability in radiomic survival analysis using small patient cohorts.

title: VLA Model Adaptation for Robotic Chess Using Real and Sim Data
summary: Fine-tuning vision-language-action models with simulated and real demonstrations is evaluated on a precise robotic chess manipulation task.

title: Offset-Free Data-Driven Predictive Control with Explicit Disturbances
summary: A novel data-driven predictive control formulation incorporates an explicit constant output-disturbance model and observer to achieve offset-free tracking.

title: Correctness Boundaries of Typed Plans in Natural-Language Robot Fleets
summary: Researchers evaluate plan validation and execution reports for natural-language command execution across a simulated twenty-robot fleet.
